paragraphs: Todd's Seeds Salad Sprouting Mixture containing broccoli, mustard, alfalfa, and cabbage is recalled nationwide for possible E. coli and Salmonella from contaminated alfalfa seed [1]. If you purchased this product from Amazon or direct consumer sales, do not use it [1]. Coco G's Courmet Flaming Cheddar Hots popcorn in 2.5 oz and 4.15 oz bags is recalled in Illinois and Wisconsin for potential Salmonella [2]. Salata Salad Kitchen Jalapeño Avocado Dressing in 12.5 fl. oz. bottles and gallon jugs is recalled in Georgia, North Carolina, and Texas due to possible Salmonella in supplier ingredients [3]. Starfish Seafood Trio cold smoked salmon, halibut, and trout in 8 oz packages is recalled because it may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes [11].

Sprouting seed recalls continue with potential Salmonella contamination [12][13]. Gardeners Basics Waltham 29 Broccoli Sprouting Seeds in one-pound bags may contain Salmonella [12]. Eden Brothers Calabrese Broccoli Seeds in 1 ounce and 1 pound sizes are recalled due to possible Salmonella [13]. Walker's Wine Juice LLC pumpkin juice is recalled for potential botulism contamination, which can cause serious illness [30].

Oliva LLC recalls Riad's Oliva to Go Baba Ghanouj, Spicy Baba Ghanouj, and Hummus for undeclared sesame that could cause serious allergic reactions [10]. Lior brand Cinnamon Ground Seasoning contains elevated lead levels [4]. Kofinas Garlic Mediterranean Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil contains unapproved garlic essential oil [5].
